# Auryx

> MD-led precision longevity clinic offering medically supervised peptide therapy protocols nationwide via telemedicine.

Auryx (also styled AURYX) is a physician-guided peptide therapy practice. Founder and medical director: Romy Fontoura, MD. Public pages are research and education. They do not replace personalized medical advice and they do not publish dosing instructions.

## About

Auryx is an MD-led telehealth clinic. Eligible patients in the United States complete a remote consultation. A licensed physician reviews history, goals, and, when indicated, biomarkers, then may prescribe a protocol fulfilled through regulated US compounding pharmacies.

- Physician leadership: https://www.auryxlife.com/about
- Clinical method: https://www.auryxlife.com/our-method
- Citations: https://www.auryxlife.com/sources
- Contact: info@auryxlife.com · https://www.auryxlife.com/contact
- Primary domain: https://www.auryxlife.com

## Services

- Peptide therapy under physician supervision
- Physician-supervised protocols (telemedicine intake, clinical review, follow-up)
- Nationwide US telemedicine with direct-to-door fulfillment when approved
- Longevity, recovery, metabolic health, and cognitive-performance education
- Protocol finder for goal-based matching: https://www.auryxlife.com/protocol-finder
- Protocol transfers from another clinic after a brief medical screen

Auryx is self-pay and does not accept insurance. The practice does not replace emergency care.
